Learning & Development Strategy | Training Program Leadership Directed end-to-end training program management, ensuring initiatives were delivered within defined timelines, budgets, and organizational performance goals.

Partnered with sales leadership and customer-facing teams through broker visits to identify market needs and design targeted capability development programs including Sales Ignition, Growth Mindset, and Negotiation Skills.
Led onboarding and orientation programs for new hires, ensuring structured capability development and improved employee performance outcomes.
Designed and developed behavior-change learning content, including e-learning modules, facilitator guides, job aids, training collateral, and demonstration-based learning models.
Aligned training initiatives with business strategy and financial objectives, ensuring measurable impact on productivity, sales effectiveness, and leadership capability.
Collaborated with HR leadership and senior stakeholders to define program priorities, roll out plans, training calendars, and ROI measurement frameworks.
Conducted strategic assessments of organization-wide learning programs to evaluate effectiveness, identify gaps, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Managed training performance metrics including trainer utilization, training throughput, certification programs, budgeting, and learning analytics.
Partnered with process managers and business leaders to align training objectives with operational requirements and organizational goals.
Implemented pilot training programs, Train-the-Trainer initiatives, and curriculum quality reviews to ensure program scalability and consistency.
Developed talent development strategies including leadership capability programs, succession planning frameworks, job rotations, and stretch assignments.
Integrated learning and development strategy with broader organizational transformation initiatives, departmental expansions, and restructuring programs.
Built role-based learning roadmaps for executives and leadership teams, aligned with business capability frameworks.
Managed external learning vendors and corporate L&D partners, ensuring effective delivery of learning solutions across multiple business verticals.
Led curriculum design initiatives leveraging adult learning principles, virtual training technologies, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

HRBP & Sales: Collaborating with cross-functional HR leaders and senior stakeholders to prioritize learning initiatives, formulating deployment strategies, and establishing performance measurement frameworks focused on ROI and business impact.
Facilitating goal-setting discussions, overseeing performance evaluation cycles, and driving continuous feedback mechanisms for the sales workforce.
Mitigating performance gaps by implementing structured Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) and monitoring progress toward defined targets.
Assessing capability gaps and recommending targeted training interventions to strengthen core sales competencies such as negotiation, relationship management, and client engagement.
Cultivating a high-performance culture by championing positive workplace behaviors, reinforcing collaborative team dynamics.
Developing and executing employee engagement initiatives to enhance workforce morale, productivity, and long-term retention.
Mediating employee relations matters while adhering to HR policies, governance frameworks, and regional labor regulations.
Administering the end-to-end employee lifecycle by managing onboarding experiences, transition processes, and exit formalities.
Conducting structured 30, 60, and 90-day integration reviews with new hires to evaluate assimilation, engagement levels, and early performance alignment.

Major Training Programs Delivered (Magicbricks Realty Services Ltd.) Delivered PAN-India in-person and virtual training initiatives focused on sales capability, leadership development, compliance, and behavioral transformation.
Key programs included: o Ethics, Integrity & Compliance Training (Home Loan Vertical) o Sales Ignition Training Program for Core Sales Teams o Conflict Management & Negotiation

Delivered classroom and virtual training programs across PAN India on ERP systems, Salesforce/CRM, Logistics Operations, Communication Excellence, Behavioral Skills, GST & E-Waybill compliance, and Business English programs.
Conducted Training Need Identification (TNI) and Training Need Analysis (TNA) to design customized learning solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
Designed and developed training content, manuals, PowerPoint presentations, assessments, and participant handbooks for multiple technical and behavioral training programs.
Facilitated Train-the-Trainer (TTT) programs for government initiatives including DDUGKY, strengthening facilitation and instructional capabilities of trainers.
Delivered online masterclasses on Communication Skills, Logistics & Supply Chain Management, and employability programs through Safejob (Safeducate’s digital learning platform).
Coordinated with internal stakeholders, regional teams, and external partners to plan and execute large-scale training rollouts across multiple locations.

Content Development: Designed learning curriculum, case studies, assessments, and participant learning materials.
Facilitation: Delivered instructor-led workshops and leadership development programs across multiple regions.
Post-Training Evaluation: Conducted training effectiveness analysis through LMS assessments, feedback analysis, and
performance tracking.
Key Program Contributions
Ethics, Integrity & Compliance Training
Designed ethics and compliance learning modules aligned with organizational policies and customer-centric practices.
Developed real-world case studies addressing ethical dilemmas, integrity issues, and compliance decision-making.
Sales Ignition Training Program
Standardized sales methodology across PAN India, covering prospecting, preparation, presentation, objection handling
closing, and follow-ups.
Integrated SPANCO sales framework and CRM adoption through Salesforce system training.
Growth Mindset Program
Designed productivity-focused learning modules helping employees transition from fixed mindset to growth mindset to
enhance resilience and performance.
Manager as Coach & Feedback Provider
Delivered leadership coaching programs using GROW coaching model and SBI feedback framework to strengthen managerial
effectiveness.
Leadership Skills for First-Time Managers
Developed leadership capability programs covering team management, conflict resolution, coaching, communication, and
team development frameworks (Tuckman Model).
Training Manager-Logistics Operations, Soft Skills, Behavioral & Process Training
Led PAN-India ERP training roll out across area offices, regional offices, franchise networks, and vendor partners.
Developed training modules covering First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile logistics processes integrated with the new
ERP platform.
Delivered hands-on system training including waybill creation, manifest generation, billing processes, and financial
documentation.
Designed training manuals, user guides, and post-training assessments to ensure adoption and knowledge retention.
Monitored field-level performance and ERP adoption among franchise owners and operational vendors.
Business Partner & Franchisee Induction Programs
Conducted structured induction programs for franchisee owners covering logistics industry overview, operational workflow
and company processes.
Delivered training on First Mile (Booking), Middle Mile (Transshipment), and Last Mile (Delivery) operations through
presentations, simulations, role-plays, and practical exercises.
Administered certification assessments at the end of induction programs to evaluate operational readiness.
Behavioral & Soft Skills Training
Facilitated behavioral and leadership development programs for executives, senior executives, managers, and business
development teams.
Delivered training on interpersonal skills, teamwork, leadership, conflict management, resilience, problem-solving, goal
setting, and stress management.
Conducted communication and workplace readiness programs including presentation skills, professionalism, adaptability
and work ethics.
Used interactive learning methodologies including demonstrations, group discussions, case studies, and role-plays.
Salesforce CRM Implementation Training
Contributed to Salesforce implementation project by designing training frameworks & supporting business process alignment.
Developed process flow diagrams and business logic mapping across sales and operational departments.
Conducted Training Need Analysis for Salesforce adoption across multiple sales teams.
Designed training manuals, presentations, and training assessments for CRM roll out.
Delivered multi-phase Salesforce training workshops across regional offices.
Cargo Cab FarEye Application Training
Designed training curriculum & lesson plans for Cargo Cab FarEye application supporting First Mile & Last Mile logistics operations.
Conducted practical system training across 18 regional offices in live operational environments.
Collaborated with regional managers and operational stakeholders for successful deployment of the application.
Communication Excellence Programs
Delivered communication effectiveness programs focusing on verbal, para-verbal, and non-verbal communication.
Trained participants on tone modulation, pitch, speech clarity, grammar usage, and positive language techniques.
Showcased body language, posture, gestures & professional communication etiquette via interactive learning methods.
Compliance & Regulatory Training
Delivered GST and E-Waybill compliance training for operational teams across PAN India to ensure regulatory adherence and
operational accuracy.
University Collaboration & Industry Programs
Partnered with universities including Chitkara University, Lovely Professional University, ITM University, GLA University
Ganpat University, and Jammu Central University to develop industry-integrated MBA/BBA programs in Logistics &
Supply Chain Management.
Delivered industrial training programs on logistics operations and supply chain processes for postgraduate and
undergraduate students.
Conducted placement readiness workshops covering behavioral skills, interview preparation, and workplace competencies.
Post-Training Evaluation & Effectiveness
Conducted post-training evaluations and effectiveness assessments to measure learning outcomes and program impact.
Prepared training effectiveness reports and feedback analysis for organizational leadership and stakeholders.
